title: New round of war with Iran 'almost' inevitable, says award-winning author Kim Ghattas
gist: Podcast episode of Al-Monitor's 'On the Middle East with Amberin Zaman' in which author Kim Ghattas argues a new round of war with Iran is 'almost' inevitable. Her book 'The Best Kind of American' uses the 1984 murder of AUB dean Malcolm Kerr to trace the chain of events leading to the US and Israeli attack on Iran, and says regional conflict engulfing Lebanon is far from over.

insights.claim: Author Kim Ghattas says a new round of war with Iran is 'almost' inevitable, following the earlier American and Israeli attack against Iran.
insights.speaker: Al-Monitor
insights.so_what: Elevated probability of renewed Iran conflict keeps a geopolitical risk premium in oil and Gulf-exposed assets.
